search_text: published ZDI-26-267 ZDI-CAN-22936 Malwarebytes Anti-Malware Uncontrolled Search Path Element Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2026-04-15 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Malwarebytes'] ['Anti-Malware'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Malwarebytes Anti-Malware. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Malwarebytes service. The issue results from loading a file from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Fixed in version 1.0.6.31 ['2024-02-29 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2026-04-15 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2026-04-15 - Advisory Updated'] Malcolm Stagg (@malcolmst) of SODIUM-24, LLC https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-26-267/
title: Malwarebytes Anti-Malware Uncontrolled Search Path Element Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Malwarebytes Anti-Malware. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Malwarebytes service. The issue results from loading a file from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.
